اصطنعت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَنَعْتُ (iṣṭanaʕtu) /isˤ.tˤa.naʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# اِصْطَنَعْتَ (iṣṭanaʕta) /isˤ.tˤa.naʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# اِصْطَنَعْتِ (iṣṭanaʕti) /isˤ.tˤa.naʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# اِصْطَنَعَتْ (iṣṭanaʕat) /isˤ.tˤa.na.ʕat/: thi
